items.title: Hartline talks about USF's offensive inconsistencies
items.summary: South Florida football hosts Memphis on Thursday night this week, and the Bulls are 1-8 against the Tigers since they joined the American Conference, with five straight losses in the series. Bulls head coach Brian Hartline is aiming to end that skid and rebound after a tough loss last week on a last-second field goal

items.title: South Florida Readies for Thursday Night Contest vs. Memphis
items.summary: TAMPA, Fla - Coming off a heartbreaking defeat at East Carolina — on a 55-yard walk-off field goal, no less — the South Florida Bulls remain intent on a strong finish. With no time to waste on another short week, there's a daunting challenge ahead.

items.title: Kick Time Announced for South Florida’s Game at FAU
items.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (November 6, 2026) – South Florida's final road game of the 2026 regular season at Florida Atlantic will kick off at 2:30 p.m. on Nov. 21 and be broadcast on ESPN+, the American Conference announced today.

items.title: 30th Anniversary Series: Essential Storylines
items.summary: Editor's Note: To commemorate the University of South Florida's 30th football season, GoUSFBulls.com is presenting a 12-part series that covers the sights, sounds, milestones, biggest games, top performers and unforgettable personalities from the program's history. The installments appear each Sunday that precedes a South Florida game week. Today's Part 9 is South Florida's Essential Storylines.

items.title: USF Football Flashback: Bulls vs. East Carolina
items.summary: Takeaways, highlights, notables, sights, sound bites and learning experiences from South Florida's 20-17 road defeat against the East Carolina Pirates.

items.title: PFF Grades: USF Bulls vs ECU
items.summary: The Bulls lost on the final play of the game at ECU on a 55-yard field goal, but the game was lost much earlier as the offense struggled for much of the day.

items.title: What He Said, What He Meant: Coach Brian Hartline After USF's Loss at ECU
items.summary: Breaking down coach Brian Hartline's Saturday press conference after South Florida's loss Friday at East Carolina.

items.title: USF Football Falls at ECU on Last Second Field Goal
items.summary: ECU hits 55-yard field goal as time expires to claim 20-17 victory.

items.title: Bulls fall on 55-yard field goal at ECU
items.summary: With starting quarterback Michael Van Buren sidelined after a big hit in the UAB win last week, the Bulls turned to Luke Kromenhoek. It wasn’t enough as the Bulls fell 20-17 on a game-winning 55-yard field goal by Andrew Conrad of the Pirates.

items.title: Bulls Hosting ‘SportsCenter on Campus’ Before Thursday Night Game vs. Memphis
items.summary: TAMPA, Fla. (November 6, 2026) – ESPN's flagship sports news program is coming to Tampa. South Florida Athletics will host ESPN 'SportsCenter on Campus' on Thursday, Nov. 12, at Bulls Bay outside of Raymond James Stadium as part of the lead-up to the Bulls' key American Conference matchup against Memphis.

items.title: Keys to the Game: Bulls vs. Pirates
items.summary: GREENVILLE, N.C. — Josh Aldridge returns to his old home Friday night, once again packing an accomplished, opportunistic defense.

items.title: Spotlight Bull: Luke Kromenhoek's Positivity is Infectious
items.summary: Whether he is the starting quarterback for Friday night's game at East Carolina or performing in a supporting role, University of South Florida quarterback Luke Kromenhoek will be ready with a positive, infectious attitude.

items.title: Know Your Opponent: East Carolina
items.summary: Q&A with Donnell Coley of The Greenville Daily Reflector on what to expect from East Carolina.

items.title: South Florida Football Hits Road for Friday Night Clash at ECU
items.summary: Regardless of who starts at quarterback … or whether the offense can awake from its slumber … or whether the defense can maintain its recent lights-out standard of play … the University of South Florida Bulls have a singular mission when they travel to East Carolina for Friday night's American Conference game on ESPN2 against the Pirates.

items.title: Hartline talks ECU and QB battle
items.summary: After a quarterback change in the UAB game, fans were curious about the status of starter Michael Van Buren, and reporters asked first-year head coach Brian Hartline about the QB situation at his Tuesday press conference. Backup Luke Kromenhoek sparked the lifeless Bulls offense in the win over UAB last Saturday.

items.title: PFF Grades: USF Bulls vs UAB
items.summary: After dropping a pair of conference games, USF's defense stepped up in a big way in the win over UAB, shutting down the Blazers.

items.title: USF Football Flashback: Bulls Defense Dominant in Downing UAB
items.summary: Bulls get six sacks, two defensive touchdowns in 30-10 victory.

items.title: Bulls flip 2027 OL Villanueva from FIU
items.summary: Rebuilding South Florida's lines of scrimmage has been a priority for first-year head coach Brian Hartline, and he added another piece of the 2027 class on Sunday evening with the commitment of Darell Villanueva. Villanueva flipped his commitment after five months to the Bulls, announcing his decision on social media.

items.title: What He Said, What He Meant: Coach Brian Hartline After USF's Win Over UAB
items.summary: Breaking down coach Brian Hartline's post-game press conference after South Florida's win Saturday over UAB.

items.title: Bulls defense guides USF to a 30-10 win over UAB
items.summary: South Florida’s defense and the legs of quarterback Luke Kromenhoek led the Bulls to their sixth win of the season, 30-10 over UAB. The defense provided 14 points alone on fumble recoveries, enough to win the game without the offense even scoring a point.

items.summary: Q&A with Charles Vaughan of AL.com on what to expect from UAB

items.title: Bulls flip UAB OL commit Mack on game week with UAB
items.summary: The South Florida Bulls need help on the offensive line in the 2027 class, and they bolstered their recruiting haul on Thursday morning with the flip of interior offensive lineman Messiah Mack. items.title: Hartline talks bye week reset for offense and defense
items.summary: USF football enjoyed a needed bye week to reset and rest before the bulk of conference play unfolds, and head football coach Brian Hartline spoke on Tuesday after a week away from the media. The Bulls host UAB at noon at Raymond James Stadium to start up the second half of the season.

items.title: Midseason defensive report card for the Bulls
items.summary: With the bye week, the USF Bulls were out of action this week, but there is a lot to examine after an entire reset of the roster in the offseason.

items.title: Midseason offensive report card for the Bulls
items.summary: The USF Bulls enter the break at 5-2 on the season so we decided to take a deep dive on the offense and how things look at the midpoint of the season.
